static_traits.name: Zhang Jie
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never experienced similar psychological issues before; never received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, highly cooperative; able to clearly express emotions and events like 'sadness, confusion, feeling rejected'; able under the counselor's guidance to identify 'mind reading/jumping to conclusions' and carry out cognitive restructuring and alternative interpretations

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling sad and rejected because best friend Abigail did not attend my birthday party, worrying she no longer wants to be friends with me.
basic_info.core_demands: I am seeking counseling because I struggle to cope with these feelings of being rejected and sadness, and I want to learn how to manage them better.

special_situations.event: Best friend Abigail did not attend my birthday party
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an important friend is absent on an important occasion, it means they do not care about me and may no longer want to be friends
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively contacting Abigail and expressing feelings; repeatedly guessing her thoughts when no clear interpretation has been obtained
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She does not want to be friends with me anymore

special_situations.event: Abigail has not replied to my messages
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If she does not reply, it means she does not care about me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently checking messages, constantly speculating about her intentions and attitude
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She definitely does not care about me anymore

special_situations.event: Abigail only said she 'cannot attend' but did not specify the reason
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no reason is given, it is mostly because I am not good enough or she no longer values me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on negative cues, ignoring positive evidence in past relationships and possible alternative explanations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She may have found new friends and does not need me anymore

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a friend is not there or absent, it proves I am not good enough for anyone
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-denial, becoming emotional and finding it hard to focus on learning and activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough for anyone

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be valued and accepted by friends, to maintain stable and close friendships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected or abandoned, no longer being cared about in the relationship
defense_goal: Reducing uncertainty and the possibility of being rejected by guessing others' thoughts in advance
Confirming relationship security through proactive communication

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough friend who may be abandoned
object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends) who no longer care about me and may distance themselves at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or encountering Abigail's absence from important occasions, not yet replying to messages, or not yet interpreting the reason
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding one's own insecurity and fear of being rejected as the other person truly not caring and about to distance themselves (transference: projecting the feeling of being abandoned onto others' motives)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tending to assert the other person's motives in declaratives (e.g. 'she does not care about me'), ignoring uncertainty; tone certain and conclusive, finding it hard to accept multiple possibilities.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking the friendship may be unstable or the other person is temporarily not around
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning uncertainty in the relationship into a wholesale negation of self-worth (e.g. 'I am not good enough for anyone')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming and negating self-statements, tone low, with absolutist language; reducing outward expression and help-seeking.

manifestations: Experiencing loneliness and isolation due to a friend's absence and non-reply
Reinforcing the subjective experience of 'being rejected' when the friend is not present
outcomes: Increased sadness and feeling of being rejected

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-denial ('I am not good enough for anyone')
Hesitating to express feelings of being rejected to family, reducing external help-seeking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing friends do not care about oneself, having found new friends and not needing oneself
Attributing unease and the feeling of being rejected to the other person's motives rather than multiple situational possibilities

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to explore alternative perspectives and cognitive restructuring
Has family support resources (parents and siblings)
Past friendships have positive evidence (mutual invitations, thoughtful gifts, shared activities)
Has proactively communicated with Abigail to express feelings
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions of mind reading and jumping to conclusions
Low sense of self-worth (believing 'I am not good enough for anyone')
Excessively focusing on whether the other person is present or replies, emotional distress affecting study and daily concentration
Hesitating to express vulnerability and feeling rejected to family, insufficient use of social support

target_behavior.behavior: Strong sadness and feeling of being rejected when a friend is absent or has not yet replied, repeatedly guessing the other person's thoughts
antecedent: Best friend not attending the birthday party
target_behavior.core_reason: Influenced by the core belief of 'I am not good enough' and mind reading/jumping to conclusions, interpreting uncertain situations as being rejected and not being cared about
target_behavior.function: Escaping the threat of uncertainty and being rejected, trying to gain relational certainty and safety through guessing
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased academic attention and affected performance; worsened low mood and loneliness; friendship strained by assumptions
